title: Manual fragment creation can overwrite an existing fragment or symlink target
body:
The manual fragment writer constructs `{timestamp}-manual-{bump_type}.md` with a timestamp resolved to one second, then calls `fs::write` on that path. A second invocation with the same bump type in that second truncates the existing fragment. A pre-existing symbolic link is followed and its target is overwritten.

Confirmed by reading current `main` at `a2749c5a7b50a22fbc8c8e2ac12deb03e7ede0a7`: [filename construction and write](https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/a2749c5a7b50a22fbc8c8e2ac12deb03e7ede0a7/scripts/create-changelog-fragment.rs#L119). This report is a source-confirmed finding; the template CLI has not been compiled or executed in this investigation.

Reproduction for a deterministic regression: extract the final fragment write into a helper accepting a path and bytes. Precreate that path with an original fragment, call the helper with different bytes, and assert the original bytes remain and the operation reports a collision. The current `fs::write` implementation fails that assertion. Also exercise two concurrent creators for the same path, a missing parent, and on Unix a symbolic link to a separate file. Exactly one concurrent creator should succeed and the winner must contain one complete fragment; a symbolic-link target must remain unchanged.

Use `OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true)` (or an equivalent exclusive creation operation) at the actual write boundary. Adding random filename text alone does not protect a pre-existing path or symbolic link. Preserve the concrete path in any failure diagnostic.

The same defect was found during [Formal AI issue #1580](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/1580). The corresponding repair and physical filesystem regressions are in [Formal AI PR #1581](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/1581), with [the shared writer and four regression cases](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/14ef1b5f8dc590733283b0e4cb0cd75e47ba89d2/scripts/changelog-fragment-file.rs). All four cases passed in [hosted core job 136121028636](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/44686151225/job/136121028636). This evidence verifies the Formal AI repair; upstream repair remains unverified.
